# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Fill this in as you work. It is the human-readable record of HOW this iteration was done and is snapshotted with the candidate, so anyone — and the next iteration via ./prior_iterations/ — can see your reasoning. Be concrete.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag (KNOWLEDGE / BEHAVIORAL / CAPABILITY-GAP) | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Hardcoded selectors / fixed row-col indices → passes visible input, fails hidden variants | 52216, 418-29, 53161 | Code fits the preview (literal `region='Metro'`, fixed row numbers) instead of reading the live control cell and matching keys; graded on 3 hidden inputs with different selector choices & sizes | KNOWLEDGE | Sharpen "write GENERAL code" with a WRONG-vs-RIGHT worked example (live-read + match-keys) |
| 2 | Reading a cell that holds a FORMULA returns the formula TEXT, so numeric aggregation silently skips it | 374-9 (partial), any SUM-of-formula-cells task | openpyxl default returns `=...` string; `isinstance(v,(int,float))` filter drops it → totals wrong | KNOWLEDGE | Worked example of `load_workbook(path, data_only=True)` reading the cached number |
| 3 | Excel-native semantics reimplemented in Python off-by-one (rolling windows, date boundaries, cross-sheet lookups) | 32468, 53161 | Python reimplementation of EOMONTH/rolling-12-month/SUMIFS gets boundaries wrong (32468 matched only 19/31 rows) | CAPABILITY-GAP (knowledge-framed) | Teach: output is recalculated by LibreOffice, so writing the correct Excel FORMULA is valid and more reliable for these |
| 4 | Delete-blank-rows/shift-up scoped only inside `answer_position` instead of the whole sheet | 160-6 | Rows below the answer window never flow up; agent rearranges only in-range values | KNOWLEDGE | Whole-sheet `ws.delete_rows` rule + `answer_position` = graded output window, not operating window |
| 5 | `answer_position` misread as the source-data extent / a window to operate inside | 418-29, 160-6 | Agent reads source only inside the range or writes outside it | KNOWLEDGE | Explicit "graded OUTPUT location, read source from wherever it lives" + coordinate worked example |
| — | Empty / contradictory task spec | 55457, 347-49 | Data defect (55457 instruction field empty; 347-49 gold inconsistent) | out of scope | skipped — not prompt-fixable |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit — aim for MULTIPLE classes, incl. a NEW tool when a cluster needs one)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Add rule + worked example (lever 5) | prompt.md §"How you are graded" | Read every selector/filter LIVE from its cell; resolve lookups by matching keys; size loops from live data; WRONG `region='Metro'` vs RIGHT `region=ws_inputs['A14'].value`. Generalizes because it states the class policy (never a task id/value). | Yes — 47484 already reads dynamically; 40467 has no selector |
| 2 | Add knowledge + worked example (lever 4) | prompt.md §"Reading cells that already contain formulas" | Open a second `data_only=True` copy to read cached formula results; note numeric-filter-drops-formula-text trap. | Yes — 47484 has 0 source formulas; 40467 doesn't read source |
| 3 | Add knowledge (lever 4) | prompt.md §"Producing and checking the output" | Output is recalculated via LibreOffice before grading, so a correct Excel FORMULA is equally valid and often MORE reliable than reimplementing EOMONTH/SUMIFS/INDEX-MATCH in Python. Kept "prefer literals when you can compute exactly" as the first choice. | Yes — verified below (recalc is active; both passing golds are formulas) |
| 4 | Add rule (lever 4) | prompt.md §"Deleting blank rows / shifting rows up" | Whole-sheet `ws.delete_rows(idx,amount)` so outside rows flow into the answer window; detect blank rows across used columns each run. | Yes — neither passing task is a delete/shift task |
| 5 | Rewrite for clarity (lever 1) + coordinate example | prompt.md §"Which cells to modify" | `answer_position` = graded output window not source extent; absolute A1 coords worked example `E2:H5`→rows2-5/cols5-8; openpyxl exact-cell targeting; `df.to_excel` drops-other-sheets caveat. | Yes — clarification, no behavior change for correctly-scoped tasks |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change: the trace it targets → what the guard/computation/new-tool now does on those exact inputs)
- Cluster 1 (52216): re-ran the failing pattern reading the selector live from its cell + matching source rows by key — produced the correct output on all 3 ground-truth input variants (3/3), vs the hardcoded version which only fit variant 1.
- Cluster 2 (374-9): confirmed openpyxl default returns the formula string and the numeric filter drops it; `data_only=True` yields the cached number and includes it (verified PASS on input 1). NOTE: 374-9 inputs 2/3 have a separate answer=2×naive-sum anomaly I could not reconcile, so I count 374-9 as a PARTIAL win, not a clean deterministic fix — the data_only rule is still correct and needed for the general SUM-of-formula-cells class.
- Cluster 3 (40467, the anchor): 40467 PASSES today by WRITING a formula (`="From "&TEXT(B1,"DD-MMM")&...`) into its target cells — this proves LibreOffice recalc IS active in the scoring pipeline (a formula-only output could not score 1.0 otherwise), so recommending formulas for 32468/53161-class tasks is grounded and safe. 32468's Python EOMONTH+11 reimplementation matched only 19/31 rows — the formula path avoids that off-by-one.
- Cluster 4 (160-6): whole-sheet `ws.delete_rows` lets rows below `answer_position` flow up; cand_0001 RESULT confirmed 160-6 FIXED with this rule.
- Cluster 5 (418-29): cand_0001 RESULT confirmed 418-29 FIXED by the live-read + answer_position-semantics edits.

## Process & features used
- Subagents / worktrees / parallel features used (or: "serial fallback because …"): Serial. I inspected ground-truth input+answer xlsx (3 variants/task) under `/vol/home/skillberry/.cache/capevolve-ci/spreadsheetbench-data/sample_data_200/spreadsheet/<task>/`, the grader `evaluation.py`, and the adapter recalc path directly with Read/Bash — cheaper than fanning out for a single-file prompt edit.
- Prior iterations I read from ./prior_iterations/ + ./RUNMAP.md (which, and what I learned): cand_0001 (RUNMAP + JOURNAL RESULT + diff). Learned: its whole batch fixed {160-6, 418-29} and broke NOTHING, but was REJECTED because Δ=+0.007 fell under the significance bar. So the edits are safe to re-introduce; this iteration must fix MORE (add the formula-writing lever + sharper worked examples) to clear the bar, not redesign the safe edits.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The "write GENERAL, data-driven code" framing with the live-read/match-keys WRONG-vs-RIGHT worked example — it is the single biggest failure class (hardcoded selectors) and verified 3/3 on 52216.
- The `data_only=True` formula-reading knowledge (needed whenever source cells hold formulas).
- The empirical fact that LibreOffice recalc is ACTIVE in scoring (40467 proves it) → writing Excel formulas is a valid, safe strategy. Do not revert the formula-option paragraph.
- Whole-sheet `delete_rows` rule (160-6) and `answer_position`=graded-output-window semantics (418-29) — both framework-confirmed fixes.
- All six original seed constraints kept intact (Cell/Sheet modify-only, prefer literals first, save+mkdir, inspect-first, read-back verify, error→fix). No global decision rule loosened; every edit is additive knowledge or narrowing.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why — already-passing / needs gold / infra noise)
- 55457 — the instruction field is genuinely EMPTY (data defect); no prompt text can supply a missing task. Out of scope.
- 347-49 — ground-truth answer is internally inconsistent with the stated instruction (contradictory gold); a correct-by-spec solution cannot match it. Out of scope.
- 374-9 inputs 2/3 — answer equals exactly 2× the naive sum with each state appearing once; could not reconcile against the instruction, so not claimed as a clean fix (data_only rule kept for the general class).
- Did NOT force openpyxl-over-pandas as a mechanic — cand_0001 refuted that as the root cause (47484 passes on pure pandas).
